Title: Nodemailer: A ";" inside a quoted string or comment ends an address group early in addressparser, turning display text into a recipient
Description: addressparser ends an RFC 5322 group at the first `;`, including one inside a quoted display name or a comment. The text after it is parsed again as top level recipients with the quoting flipped, so text that every conformant parser reads as a display name or comment becomes a live address. `G: (a; <evil@evil.com>) <v@victim.com>;` names only `v@victim.com`, and Nodemailer read it as the single recipient `evil@evil.com`. Affected: 3.0.0 through 10.1.3.
NotImpacted: All versions before 3.0.0, all versions starting from 10.1.4
